claims.text: Text segmentation involves splitting lengthy documents into smaller chunks to encapsulate context and improve results.
The process mimics human reading behavior, allowing for better memory storage and understanding of the document's context.
Document segmentation is analogous to audio segmentation, where distinct segments are created for better classification and analysis.
